build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search parameters
build_physics_scene: build a physics scene with slope, container, platform, block, and ball objects using build_task
add_convex_polygon: add a convex polygon shape to the PHYRE scene using C.add_convex_polygon with vertex coordinates
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene using C.add with radius and position parameters
update_task_goal: update the task goal by setting body relationships like TOUCHING using C.update_task
